summary: The Patriots upset the Broncos 26-23 on Christmas Eve at Empower Field at Mile High when kicker Chad Ryland hit a 56-yard field goal late. New England led 23-7 before Denver rallied with 16 fourth-quarter points to tie the game. The note is a live-blog recap with scoring plays, pregame inactives, and broadcast details.
one_line: Patriots beat the Broncos 26-23 on Chad Ryland's 56-yard field goal after Denver erased a 23-7 deficit in the fourth quarter.
key_facts: The Patriots beat the Broncos 26-23 on Sunday, Dec. 24, 2023, at Empower Field at Mile High.
Patriots kicker Chad Ryland hit a 56-yard game-winning field goal at 11:20 p.m. ET after missing a 47-yard try earlier.
New England entered 3-11 and moved to 4-11, which hurt its 2024 NFL Draft positioning.
Denver fell to 7-8, putting its playoff hopes on ice though it was not formally eliminated.
Broncos quarterback Russell Wilson finished 25-of-37 for 238 yards with two touchdowns.
Denver scored 16 points in the fourth quarter, including a 3-yard TD to Lucas Krull and a 21-yard TD to Brandon Johnson, each with a successful two-point conversion.
The Patriots led 23-7 after Ezekiel Elliott's 15-yard TD run, Bailey Zappe's 11-yard TD pass to Mike Gesicki, and Cody Davis's 1-yard fumble-recovery TD.
Javonte Williams scored the Broncos' first touchdown on a 3-yard rush; Denver led 7-3 at halftime.
Broncos receiver Courtland Sutton was ruled out with a concussion; Brandon Johnson and Jerry Jeudy also featured in Denver's comeback drives.
Denver's Lutz missed a 57-yard field goal attempt in the first half.
The Patriots offense ranked 28th in the league entering the game but totaled 289 yards and 23 offensive points.
Matthew Slater, JuJu Smith-Schuster, Rhamondre Stevenson, Jabrill Peppers and Hunter Henry were among the Patriots' inactives.
The game aired on NFL Network with Rich Eisen on play-by-play and Kurt Warner as color analyst, kicking off at 8:15 p.m. ET.
